title: Metrics, glyph plans, transformation and packaging
summary: FontManager centralises measurement and glyph identity. FontGlyphPlan provides Unicode-to-glyph identity, advances and SFNT geometry; transformers provide subset/package output including WOFF/WOFF2 without making fontTools compulsory.
invariants: Repeated renderer width decisions should use FontGlyphPlan measurement rather than spawning an external tool for each line-break probe.
If no exact metrics provider exists, approximate measurement must be labelled approximate rather than presented as authoritative.
Subsetting is requested through FontPackageRequest/Result and transformer providers.
Subset corpus is transported through a UTF-8 text file, not shell-quoted command-line text.
FontTools and pyftsubset are optional providers, not dependencies of the FontManager semantic API.

provenance.claim: dev2 glyph-plan, metrics hot-path and text-file subsetting changes.
Central metrics/glyph provider registration with explicitly approximate fallback.
pyftsubset transformer, UTF-8 text-file subset corpus and WOFF/WOFF2 flavor support.
